name: publicWeb_getOfficialTrail
description: A run's official (hare's) trail for the public run page (E5.F6.S6, James 2026-10-03): one lane per trail type, drawn as THE trail, its length shown as the run's distance, downloadable as GPX. Hidden until the run has ENDED — EventStartDatetimeGmt + 4 hours — so a trail is never public while it is being run (the same rule as hcapp_getOfficialTrail's 'everyone else'). The public OfficialTrailInfo is rebuilt from the stored JSON with only type, distanceM, points and source per lane: setBy (an internal user id) and sourceRef (a runner's or file name) stay off the web. No authentication — anonymous PublicWebApi GET. Read-only.

columns.name: EventFound
columns.description: 1 when a live, visible run matches (deleted = 0, removed = 0, IsVisible = 1).

columns.name: Available
columns.description: 1 when the run has an OfficialTrailGzip AND start + 4 h has passed; 0 = none set, not yet public, or not found.

columns.name: OfficialTrailInfo
columns.description: When Available = 1 and the stored OfficialTrailInfo is valid JSON: {"lanes":[{type, distanceM, points, source}]} (FOR JSON PATH, ROOT('lanes')). NULL otherwise.

columns.name: OfficialTrail
columns.description: CAST(DECOMPRESS(Event.OfficialTrailGzip) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) — {"lanes":[{"type":3,"points":[[lat,lon],...]}]}; points may carry a third element t (ms after the first point).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: Line 56 logs ErrorName 'Unhandled error in getOfficialTrail' (no publicWeb_ prefix) and HcVersion '<unknown>' where the other public-web SPs write '<web>'. ProcName is correct, so it is still findable.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
